αἰδοίη: αἰδοῖος — held in respect, revered; fem. nom. sg. · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’revered one’ (ὦ γύναι αἰδοίη)
αἰδομένη: αἰδέομαι — feel shame before, show respect for; pres. part. mid., fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic αἰδουμένη)
αἰετὸς: ἀετός — eagle; masc. nom. sg., epic αἰετός (= Attic ἀετός)
αἰνὸν: αἰνός — dread, fearsome, grim; neut. nom./acc. sg. (αἰνὸν ἄχος ’fearsome grief’)
αἱ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. pl. ’they’, referring to the ships (αἱ δ’ ... ἔπλεον) · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of women (αἱ δ’ ὅτε ... ἵκοντο ’and when they came’) · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of the mules (αἱ δ’ ὦκα λίπον ’and they quickly left’) · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of the islands (αἱ δέ τ’ ἄνευθε ’and they lie apart’) · also fem. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the others’ (αἱ ἄλλαι ’the other ships’) · also fem. nom. pl., correlative, of the doors: αἱ μὲν … αἱ δ’ ’the one … the other’ · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of the swine (αἱ δὲ νέμονται ’and they graze’) · also fem. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (αἱ κύνες ’the dogs’)
αὐτή: αὐτός — self; fem. nom. sg., intensive, stressing the subject herself: ’(you) yourself’ · also intensive, 1st person: ’I myself’ (αὐτή μιν πόμπευον ’I myself escorted him’)
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg.: ’himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼν αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’yourself’ (εἰδήσεις δὲ καὶ αὐτός ’you will see for yourself’) · also masc. nom. sg., of a thing: ’it itself’ (αὐτὸς … σίδηρος ’iron of itself’)
αὖτε: αὖτε — again, in turn, on the other hand; adv.
αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
βάλε: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβαλε): ’cast’ · also ’hit, strike’, with the person or part struck as object: ’struck’ (βάλε δεξιὸν ὦμον ’struck the right shoulder’)
βάλλεο: βάλλω — throw, put; mid. put (in one’s mind); pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -εο (= Attic βάλλου)
βεβήκει: βαίνω — go, walk, step; plpf. 3 sg. with simple past force (Homeric pluperfect): ’had gone, went’
βιότοιο: βίοτος — life, livelihood; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
βλεφάροισι: βλέφαρον — eyelid; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γένοιτο: γίγνομαι — become, happen, turn out; aor. opt. 3 sg. (ὅπως ἄριστα γένοιτο ’how it might turn out best’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish with μή: μὴ ... φίλον γένοιτο ’may it not prove pleasing’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish after αἲ γάρ: αἲ γὰρ τοῦτο γένοιτο ’would that this might happen’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish after εἰ γάρ: εἰ γὰρ … ἔρις γένοιτο ’if only a contest might arise’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a fear clause after μή: ’lest it come to be’ (μὴ … ἀμφαδὰ ἔργα γένοιτο ’lest the matter become public’)
γήμασθ: γαμέω — marry; aor. inf. mid., elided (γήμασθ’ = γήμασθαι), of a woman, used as an imperative: ’marry!’
γίγνοντ: γίγνομαι — become, come to be; pres. 3 pl. mid., elided (γίγνοντ’ = γίγνονται)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γλαυκῶπις: γλαυκῶπις — epithet of Athena: ’gleaming-eyed’ (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain); fem. nom. sg.
γοόωσα: γοάω — wail, sob, lament; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic γοῶσα)
γρηῢς: γρηῦς — old woman; fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic γραῦς)
γύναι: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. voc. sg.: ’wife’ · also fem. voc. sg., plain address to a woman who is not a wife: ’woman’ (χαῖρε, γύναι ’be glad, woman’)
δάκρυσ: δάκρυ — tear; neut. dat. pl., elided (δάκρυσ’ = δάκρυσι)
δέμνια: δέμνιον — bedstead, bed; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., in apposition to εὐναί: ’bedding’
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δήμοιό: δῆμος — people, community; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
δίφρον: δίφρος — chariot-platform, chariot; masc. acc. sg. · also stool, seat (of the carver’s seat)
δίχα: δίχα — apart, in two, asunder; adv. (δίχα ... ἥνδανε βουλή, lit. ’counsel pleased split in two’, i.e. was divided)
δαίμων: δαίμων — a god, some divine power (vague, unspecified); masc. nom. sg.
δι: διά — through; prep. + acc., elided (δι’ = διά): ’through (the night)’ · also + gen.: ’through, through the midst of’ (δι’ αὐτῶν ’through the midst of them’)
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: διὰ … τινάξῃ = διατινάξῃ ’shake apart, shatter’ · also + acc., causal, ’through, thanks to, by the aid of’ (διὰ … Ἀθήνην) · also as adverb/preverb in tmesis with κοσμηθέντες (διὰ … κοσμηθέντες = διακοσμηθέντες ’drawn up in divisions’) · also + gen., ’through, among’ (διὰ μήλων ’among the flocks’) · also prep. + gen., ’through’ (διὰ πτόλιος ’through the city’)
διὲκ: διέκ — out through, right through; prep. + gen. (διά + ἐκ, epic)
δμῶάς: δμῳή — female slave, maidservant; fem. acc. pl., epic (= Attic δούλας)
δυοκαίδεκα: δυοκαίδεκα — twelve; numeral, indeclinable (= Attic δώδεκα)
δόμοις: δόμος — house; masc. dat. pl.: ’in houses’ (ἐν postponed, with anastrophe) · also plural for a single house, after ἐν: ἐν Ἀτρεΐδαο δόμοις ’in the house of Atreus’ son’
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖαν: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; fem. acc. sg. δῖαν, here extended to the sea (ἅλα δῖαν ’the heavenly brine’) rather than a hero · also of a place-name: Λακεδαίμονα δῖαν ’heavenly Lacedaemon’ · also of Dawn: Ἠῶ δῖαν ’heavenly Dawn’
δῶμα: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb: ’the house’
εἰλήλουθα: ἔρχομαι — come, go; redupl. perf. 1 sg., epic (= Attic ἐλήλυθα): ’I have come’
εἰποῦσ: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (εἰποῦσ’ = εἰποῦσα)
εἰρήσομαι: εἴρομαι — ask, question; fut. 1 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ἐρήσομαι)
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’) · also in the idiom εἰς ὅ (κε) ’until’: εἰς ὅ κεν … μιγήῃς ’until you mingle with’ · also in the idiom εἰς ὅτε (κε) + subj., ’until the time when’ (εἰς ὅτε κέν … καθέλῃσι ’until … brings down’)
εἰσαναβᾶσα: εἰσαναβαίνω — go up into; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg. (aor. εἰσανέβην): ’having gone up’
εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. (accented εἴ before a following enclitic, περ among them) · also introducing an indirect question, ‘whether’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ’ εἴ κέ ... ‘who knows whether’) · also with opt., of an aim in view: ’in case, to see if’ (εἴ τινά … λάβοι ’in case he might catch someone’) · also in ὡς εἴ τ’ + opt., ’as if’ · also in ὡς εἴ τε with no verb or optative expressed: ’as if’
εἴα: ἐάω — allow, permit; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’allowed’
εἶσι: εἶμι — go, come; pres. 3 sg. used with future sense: ’will come’ · also pres. 3 sg. with present force: ’goes, ranges’ (Ἄρτεμις εἶσι κατ’ οὔρεα ’Artemis ranges over the mountains’)
εὐνήν: εὐνή — bed, bedding, marriage-bed; fem. acc. sg. · also of an animal’s lair, den (ἑὴν εἰσήλυθεν εὐνήν ’came into his own lair’, of the lion in the simile)
ζείδωρον: ζείδωρος — grain-giving (of ploughland); fem. acc. sg.; meaning disputed: usually ’giving ζειά (a kind of grain)’, an ancient alternative reads ’life-giving’ (from ζάω)
θάρσει: θαρσέω — be of good courage, take heart; pres. imper. 2 sg.
θαμὰ: θαμά — often, again and again; adv.
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θύραζε: θύραζε — to the outside, out of doors; adv., directional suffix -δε (= -ζε after a vowel)
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὃς δέ κ’ … ἵκηται ’whoever comes’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κ’ ἐλθὼν … εἴποιμι ’and I would go and tell’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καί νύ κ’ … ἔδυ ’and … would have set’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’will’ (τοὺς δέ κ’ … θέλξει ’and then … will enchant them’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ μέν κ’ αἰνήσωσι ’if they approve’) · also + opt. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (τόν κ’ εἴ μοι δοίης ’if you would give me him’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κ’ αὐτὸν γνώω ’if I come to know him’) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κ’ … ἐρεθίζω ’so that I may provoke’) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that’ (ὥς κ’ … ἵκηται ’so that he may reach’)
κάλυψε: καλύπτω — cover, hide; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκάλυψε)
κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κέ τοι λύσῃ ’so that she may free’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ ποθι Ζεὺς δώῃ ’if Zeus should somehow grant’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (εἴ κέ τιν’ … εὕρωμεν ’if we should find any’) · also + opt. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ μοι … παρασταίης ’if you would stand by me’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: τῷ κέ με … ὤνησεν ’would have benefited me’ · also + fut./short-vowel aor. subj. in a main clause: κέ τοι καταλέξω ’I shall tell you’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (εἴ κέ μιν ἀγγείλαιμι ’if I might report him’) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ τοι φήνωσι ’until they show you’) · also + subj. in a prospective relative clause: ’who shall’ (ὅς κέ με κεῖσ’ ἀγάγῃ ’who shall lead me there’) · also + fut. indic. (or short-vowel subj.) in a clause after εἴ: ’whether perhaps’ (εἴ κέ σφι … τελευτήσει ’whether … it will come to pass for them’) · also + opt., potential, in a main clause: ’might’ (καί κέ τεο … πειρηθεῖμεν ’we might test any of’)
κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + aor. indic., unreal past: κέν μοι … κατέχευας ’you would have poured on me’ · also + subj. in a main clause: ’may’ (καί κέν οἱ ὑπέρσχῃ χεῖρα ’and he may hold his hand over him’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (κέν μοι … εἴη ’would be mine’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέν τις … ὀρέξῃ ’if perhaps someone holds out’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κέν … μεταλλῶσιν ’whenever they ask’) · also + opt., potential, in a clause with ὅ ’that’: ’might’ (ὅ κέν τις … ἀμύνοι ’that someone might defend’)
κίον: κίω — go, move; epic impf. 3 pl. (= ἐπορεύοντο), unaugmented
κακοΐλιον: Κακοΐλιος — ’Evil Ilium’, ill-omened Troy (κακός + Ἴλιος); fem. acc. sg.
καλόν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg. agreeing with a noun (καλόν τε μέγαν τε ’fine and tall’) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun (of a gift: τιμῆεν, μάλα καλόν ’precious, very fine’)
καλὸν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg. (agreeing with a noun) · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’beautifully’ (with an infinitive) · also neut. acc. sg. used as a noun, direct object: ’a fine one’ (μάλα καλὸν ἑλών) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive, agreeing with a stated neut. noun: ’fine’ (καλὸν δέπας ’the fine cup’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’fair, fine’ (ὕδωρ καλὸν ’fair water’) · also neut. acc. sg., adverbial or cognate with a finite verb: οὐ καλὸν ἔειπες ’you have not spoken well’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with an infinitive as subject: ’a fine thing (to hear)’
κατ: κατά (elided κατ’) — down from, throughout; + gen./acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (κατ’ … ἕζετο = κατέζετο ’sat down’)
κατέδουσιν: κατεσθίω — eat up, devour; pres. 3 pl., from the epic present κατέδω (= Attic κατεσθίουσιν)
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (κατὰ πετράων ’down from the rocks’) · also + gen., ’all over, throughout’ (κατὰ σπείους κέχυτο ’lay spread all over the cave’) · also + acc., of the part grasped: ’by’ (κατὰ νῶτα λαβών ’taking him by the back’) · also + acc., ’on account of, on the business of’ (κατὰ χρέος ’on business’) · also + gen., ’down in, within’ (κατὰ σπείους κοίλοιο δέδυκεν ’is sunk in the hollow cave’) · also + acc., of the place struck: ’in, on’ (κατὰ δεξιὸν ὦμον ’on the right shoulder’)
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … ἐποτρύνῃ ’until … urges on’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κε πίῃ) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever, as soon as’ (ὅτε … κε θάνῃσιν; ἐπεί κε … λίπῃ) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κε … ἀκούσῃς) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κε λίσσηαι ’but if you beg’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καὶ νύ κε … βάλεν ’and she would have hurled’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κε θάνωμεν ’either we may die’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κε … μαχοίμην ’I would fight’) · also + subj. in a relative clause of purpose: ’who are to’ (οἵ κε … ἀγγείλωσι ’who are to announce’) · also + fut. indic. (or short-vowel subj.) in a main clause: ’will’ (αἶψά κε … ἀποτίσεται ’at once he will exact payment’) · also + aor. in a general relative clause: ’who would (decide)’ (οἵ κε … ἔκριναν)
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … δαινύῃ ’whenever you feast’) · also + subj. in the protasis of a condition after αἴ: ’if ever’ · also + opt., potential: ’might, may’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κεν … ἀφικοίμεθα ’but if we should reach’) · also + fut. indic. or short-vowel subj. in an apodosis: ’will’ (αἶψά κεν … τεύξομεν ’at once we will build’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἴ κεν … ἵκωμαι ’if I should come’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κεν ἁλώῃ ’or he may be caught’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κεν ὀπυίῃ ’whoever marries’) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν ἔλθω ’until I come’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause or an indirect disjunctive question: ’shall’ (ἤ κεν … δυνησόμεθ’ ’whether we shall be able’) · also + fut. indic. in a relative clause: ’who will’ (ὅς κεν … ἐποίσει ’who will lay on’) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κεν … καταθείομαι ’so that I may put away’)
κεράων: κέρας — horn; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κερῶν): ’by the horns’
κεῖνος: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
κηδόμενόν: κήδομαι — be troubled, distressed, grieve; pres. part. masc. acc. sg. (accent from the following enclitic περ)
κλαῖον: κλαίω — weep, wail; impf. 1 sg. · also impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔκλαιον): ’they wept’
κοίτοιο: κοῖτος — bed, rest, going to bed; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
κουρίδιον: κουρίδιος — wedded, lawful (of a husband or wife); masc. acc. sg.
κούρη: κούρη — girl, daughter; fem. nom. sg.
κοῖτος: κοῖτος — bed, sleep, lying down; masc. nom. sg.
κραίνουσι: κραίνω — accomplish, rule; pres. 3 pl.: ’they rule’
κτήσιος: Κτήσιος — Ctesius, a man’s name (Eumaeus’ father); masc. nom. sg.
κτεῖνε: κτείνω — kill, slay; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκτεινε): ’killed’
κτῆσιν: κτῆσις — possessions, property; fem. acc. sg.
κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect (φίλον κῆρ ’in his own heart’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a verb: κῆρ ἤθελε ’my heart wished’ · also κήρ — death-fate, doom; fem. acc. sg., elided (κῆρ’ = κῆρα): ’death-fate’ (θάνατον καὶ κῆρ’ ’death and doom’)
κῆρας: κήρ — doom, fate of death, death-spirit; fem. acc. pl.
λέξομαι: λέγω (II) — lay down; mid. lie down, go to bed; fut. 1 sg. mid.: ’I will lie down’
λίπ: λίπα — richly, thickly; adv. (perh. instead an elided case-form of a noun ’fat’, cf. λίπος), elided (λίπ’ = λίπα) · also λείπω — leave; aor. imper. 2 sg., elided (λίπ’ = λίπε): ’leave (me)’
λαερτιάδεω: Λαερτιάδης — son of Laertes; masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου), a patronymic of Odysseus
λεξαίμην: λέγω — lay; mid. lie down (root of λέχος ’bed’; distinct from λέγω ’say’); aor. opt. mid. 1 sg.: ’I would/might lie down’
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέγας: μέγας — great, big, grown; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’grown’ · also plain attributive adj., masc. nom. sg., ’great, huge’ (μέγας σῦς ’a great boar’), not predicate
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ (the acute μέν is kept before a following enclitic; elsewhere μὲν) · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’ (οὐ μέν ’not indeed’) · also μένω — stay, wait; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (μέν’ = μένε): ’stay’
μέτρον: μέτρον — measure, full measure; neut. acc. sg. (ἥβης μέτρον ’the measure of manhood’)
μεγάροιο: μέγαρον — hall; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
μεγάροις: μέγαρον — hall, great room; neut. dat. pl.: ‘in the halls’
μεγάροισι: μέγαρον — hall; dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
μεγάροισιν: μέγαρον — hall, great room, house; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν), plural for a single house
μηκέτι: μηκέτι — no longer, not any more; neg. adv., used with subj./imper. in prohibitions
μνηστήρεσσιν: μνηστήρ — suitor; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
μνηστῆρες: μνηστήρ — suitor; nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’suitors!’
μνᾶται: μνάομαι — woo, court; pres. 3 sg. mid.
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of the person affected, ’from my …’ (μοι βλεφάρων ἐξέσσυτο ὕπνος ’sleep rushed out from my eyelids’) · also dat. of possession with εἰμί: ’who are mine’ (οἵ μοι ἔασιν ’who are mine’)
μοῖραν: μοῖρα — due share, what is fitting, portion, fate; fem. acc. sg. (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’)
μύθων: μῦθος — speech, word, thing said (not yet ’myth’ in Homer); gen. pl.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
νέον: νέος — new, young; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’newly, for the first time’ · also masc. acc. sg., ’young’ (νέον ἄνδρα ’a young man’) · also neut. nom./acc. sg., ’new’ (οὔ τι νέον ’not a new one’, of a debt) · also adv., ’just now, a moment ago’ (νέον ἠὲ πάροιθεν ’just now than before’; νέον ἦσθα γέρων ’just now you were an old man’)
νήπιος: νήπιος — infant, still a child, witless; masc. nom. sg.
ξεῖν: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend; voc. sg., elided (ξεῖν’ = ξεῖνε)
ξεῖνε: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); voc. sg.
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’) · also article-like with a numeral and noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’the’ (οἱ δὲ δύω σκόπελοι ’the two crags’) · also encl. dat. sg. of a thing, ’to/for it’ (δύω δέ τέ οἱ θύραι ’and it has two doors’) · also article-like with a noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’those, the’ (οἱ πέπλοι ’the robes’) · also dat. sg. of the giver with δέχομαι: ’from him’ (οἱ ἐδέξατο ’took from him’)
οἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
οἴη: οἶος — alone, only; fem. nom. sg.
οἴκου: οἶκος — house, household; masc. gen. sg.
οἴκτρ: οἰκτρός — pitiable, piteous; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided (οἴκτρ’ = οἰκτρά): ’piteously’
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (= οἱ, accented οἵ in this position) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; masc. nom. pl. ’they’, demonstrative: οἵ γ’ ὑβρισταί ’are they violent?’
οἶκον: οἶκος — house, household (and its stores); acc. sg.
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐλὴν: οὐλή — scar, healed wound; fem. acc. sg. (grave accent mid-clause; not οὖλος ’thick, woolly’)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. gen. sg.: ’whose’ (= Attic οὗ) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐξ οὗ ’since, from the time when’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own; masc. gen. sg. agreeing with a noun (οὗ πατρὸς ’her own father’s’)
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg.: ’all’ (πάντα δῆμον ’all the people’) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbial: ’altogether, in every respect’ (οὐκ ἄρα πάντα νοήμονες ’not altogether sensible’)
πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv., with inf. like Attic πρίν · also a plain temporal adverb with a finite verb, not paired with an infinitive: ’formerly, in the past’ (αἳ πάρος ἦσαν ’who formerly were’) · also ’before (that)’ with a finite verb, in the past: πάρος δ’ εἰς Ἴλιον ᾤχετο ’before that he went to Ilios’ · also with a participle: ’formerly, before’ (πάρος περ ἐὼν ’though formerly being’)
πένθος: πένθος — grief, sorrow; neut. nom./acc. sg.
πέφραδ: φράζω — point out, show, tell; reduplicated aor. 3 sg., elided (πέφραδ’ = πέφραδε)
παιδὶ: παῖς — child, son; masc. dat. sg.
παλάμῃσι: παλάμη — palm, hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
παρήμενος: πάρημαι — sit beside, sit near (+ dat.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · also used as an adverb with no case expressed: ’beside, alongside’ (παρὰ … ἐτάνυσσε τράπεζαν ’drew a table up beside (them)’) · also + acc., ’beside, contrary to’ (παρὰ μοῖραν ’beside what is fitting’)
παῖδ: παῖς — child, daughter; fem. acc. sg., elided (παῖδ’ = παῖδα) · also masc. acc. sg. (παῖς is common gender; here of a son, Telemachus): ’son’ · also masc. acc. dual, elided (παῖδ’ = παῖδε), with δύο: ’two sons’
παῖς: παῖς — child, son, daughter; nom. sg.
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’ · also after εἰ, ’if indeed, even if’: εἴ περ γάρ κεν ’if indeed ever’
περίφρων: περίφρων — circumspect, of sound understanding; fem. nom. sg., stock epithet of Penelope · also epithet of Arete: fem. nom. sg., ’the circumspect queen’ · also epithet of Eurycleia: fem. nom. sg., ’circumspect Eurycleia’
πεφυρμένη: φύρω — mix, mingle, soil; perf. pass. part. fem. nom. sg., + dat.: ’mingled, drenched (with tears)’
πηνελόπεια: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope, wife of Odysseus; nom. sg.
ποδάνιπτρα: ποδάνιπτρον — foot-bath, water for washing the feet; neut. nom. pl. (plural for a single act)
πολλὸν: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, epic (= Attic πολύ): ’much’ · also attributive, neut. nom. sg. agreeing with μέθυ: ’much (wine)’ · also neut. acc. sg. as substantive object: ’much (wine)’ · also adj.: ’big’ · also epic πολλόν (= πολύν), masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόνον: ’long (time)’
πολύμητις: πολύμητις — of many wiles, epithet of Odysseus (built on μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’); masc. nom. sg.
ποτε: ποτέ — once, at some time, formerly; enclitic adv.
ποτὲ: ποτέ — once, at some time, some day; adv.
πριστοῦ: πριστός — sawn, cut with a saw; masc. gen. sg.
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
πρὶν: πρίν — before, until; adv./conj., + inf. (grave, mid-clause form) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article: ‘formerly, at first’, no infinitive · also bare adv. ’formerly’, no art./inf. · also + aor. subj., ’before’ (πρὶν … ἐπέλθῃ ’before it comes upon’) · also + opt.: ’before’ (πρὶν τλαίη ’before he would bring himself’) · also adv. with a finite verb, ’before that, sooner’ (πρὶν … ἀγείρετο ’before that … came gathering’) · also + fut. indic.: ’before’ (πρὶν … γαῖα καθέξει ’before the earth covers’) · also with a bare noun, the verb understood: ’before’ (πρὶν ὥρη ’before it is time’)
πυκιναὶ: πυκινός — close-packed, thick, close; fem. nom. pl.
πυκινοῖσιν: πυκινός — close-packed, tightly-stitched, close; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οῖς) · also masc. dat. pl.; of words and thoughts, ’shrewd, well-knit’
πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)
πόρε: πόρω (defective, aor. only) — furnish, grant, give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’gave’ · also aor. imper. 2 sg. (same form): τοῦτο πόρε ’give this!’
πόσιν: πόσις — husband; acc. sg. · also the distinct noun πόσις ’a drinking, drink’ (from πίνω); acc. sg.: ’drink’ (paired with βρῶσις ’eating’)
πόσιος: πόσις — drinking; gen. sg. (abstract noun, distinct from πόσις ’husband’) · also πόσις — husband; masc. gen. sg. (εὐνὴν … πόσιος ’her husband’s bed’)
πόσις: πόσις — husband, spouse; masc. nom. sg. (distinct from πόσις ’drink’) · also πόσις — drink; fem. nom. sg. (βρῶσίς τε πόσις τε ’food and drink’)
πότμον: πότμος — fate, doom, death; masc. acc. sg.
πᾶσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl.
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’ · also σός — your, yours; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (σ’ = σά): τὰ σ’ αὐτοῦ κήδε’ ’your own troubles’
σιγαλόεντα: σιγαλόεις — glossy, gleaming (sense uncertain); neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χιτῶνα: ’gleaming’
στονόεσσα: στονόεις — full of groaning, mournful; adj., fem. nom. sg., epic -όεσσα
στὰς: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having stood, standing’
σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also as adverb, ’together’, or as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: σὺν … κάλυψε = συνεκάλυψε ’covered up’; σὺν … ἔπεσον = συνέπεσον ’fell together, clashed’ · also adverb ’along, with (us)’ construed with ἔχοντες, which takes the object (σὺν … χεῖρας ἔχοντες ’having hands along with us’)
σῇσιν: σός — your, yours; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αῖς), agreeing with φρεσί
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’ · also after ἤ ’than’, with no connective force: ἤ τ’ οἰωνοί ’than birds’
τάχ: τάχα — soon, quickly, perhaps; adv., elided (τάχ’ = τάχα)
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, also marks a standing fact (epic τε) · also in the idiom ὅ τε (= ὅτι) ’in that, because’, giving a reason: ὅ τέ με … ἀποβῆναι ἀνώγει ’in that he bids me step off’ · also in ἦ τέ, a strengthened affirmation: ’truly’ (ἦ τέ μ’ ἔφαντο ’who truly said’)
τέρπειν: τέρπω — give delight, gladden; pres. inf.
τέρπομ: τέρπομαι — take delight, find pleasure; pres. 1 sg. mid., elided (τέρπομ’ = τέρπομαι)
τέτυκται: τεύχω — make, build; pass. come to pass, happen; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been made, has come to pass’
τήν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg., resumptive: ’whom’ · also demonstrative, fem. acc. sg., resuming an earlier noun: ’her’ (τήν … ῥέξω ’her I will sacrifice’) · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὀιζυῖ πολλῇ, τήν μοι ἐπῶρσε ’great misery, which he roused for me’) · also demonstrative with a noun and adjective: ’that’ (τήν γε στυγερὴν ὁδόν ’that hateful journey’)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τελέει: τελέω — accomplish, complete, fulfill; fut. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic τελεῖ)
τελείεται: τελείω (τελέω) — fulfil, bring to pass; pres. 3 sg. pass., epic: ’is fulfilled, comes true’
τετελεσμένον: τελέω — bring to pass, fulfil; perf. pass. part. neut. nom. sg., periphrastic with ἔσται: ’shall stand fulfilled’ · also periphrastic with the pres. ἐστίν rather than fut. ἔσται, of a thing already fixed by fate: ’it is a thing ordained, it is decreed’ · also periphrastic with the opt. εἴη, in a wish: ’may it be fulfilled’ (τετελεσμένον εἴη)
τετεύχαται: τεύχω — make, do, work; perf. pass. 3 pl., Ionic -αται (= Attic -νται): ’have been done’
τεὸς: τεός — your, yours; epic (= Attic σός); masc. nom. sg.
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’ · also as a substantive object in a statement: ’something’ (καί τι ἴσασι ’they know something’)
τινά: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., indefinite, accented before enclitic οἱ (with ὅν: ὅν τινα ’whatever’) · also neut. acc. pl., ’any’, with an understood noun (εἴ τινά που δεδάηκας ’if you have learned any’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τούτους: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; demonstr. pron., masc. acc. pl.
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. pl. (ἀέθλους, τοὺς … ἐπειρήσαντο Ὀδυσῆος ’the contests with which they tried Odysseus’) · also demonstrative with a noun: masc. acc. pl. ’those, the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους … ἑταίρους ’the rest of my companions’)
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whose, of whom; masc. gen. sg. (τοῦ νῶι θεοῦ ὣς τερπόμεθ’ αὐδῇ ’whose voice we delight in’) · also demonstrative gen. of comparison after a comparative: τοῦ γε κρεῖσσον ’better than this’ · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ: ’from that time’ · also neut. gen. sg., partitive, ’of it’ (τοῦ μὲν ὅσον τ’ ὄργυιαν ’of it, about a fathom’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the’ (τοῦ παιδὸς ’that son’) · also article-like gen. sg. with a noun and a participle (gen. absolute), distributive: ’of the one … of the other’ (τοῦ μὲν φθίνοντος μηνός, τοῦ δ’ ἱσταμένοιο ’as one month wanes and the other begins’)
τοῦτον: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. acc. sg.
τυτθὸν: τυτθός — small, little; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’when small’
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. sg.
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; neut. nom. pl. (μῆλα, τὰ … κατάκειτ’ ’the flocks, which lie’) · also relative, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’, object of the verb in its clause (ῥωγαλέα, τὰ … ὅρηαι ’torn, which you see’) · also article-like with a substantivized adjective, neut.: ’the (worse things)’ (τὰ χέρεια)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’ · also ’it’, of a thing (τὴν = the clothing): fem. acc. sg. · also with a noun, article-like: τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom; fem. acc. sg. (τὴν Ὠκεανὸς τέκε ’whom Oceanus begot’) · also ’the other’, contrasted with a preceding τὴν … μέν: fem. acc. sg. (τὴν δέ ’the other one’) · also article-like with a numeral: ’the one’ (τὴν μὲν ἴαν ’the one portion’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. (τὸ πάροιθεν ’that which was before’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’that, the’ (τὸ σῆμα ’that mark’) · also article-like before the adverb πάρος: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ) · also article-like before an ordinal, adverbial: τὸ τρίτον ’the third time’ · also distributive, neut. nom./acc. sg.: τὸ μὲν … τὸ δὲ ’one thing … another’ · also article-like before the adverb πρόσθεν: ’formerly’ (τὸ πρόσθεν ὄλοντο ’died long before’) · also article-like before a substantivized adjective, neut.: τὸ μέλαν ’the dark (part)’ · also article-like before the adverb πάροιθε: ’formerly’ (τὸ πάροιθε ’in former times’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’) · also article-like with a participle: τὸν ἐόντα ’me, the one who am’ · also article-like with a superlative or ordinal: ’the best’ (τὸν ἄριστον), ’the fourth’ (τὸν τέταρτον) · also article-like with a substantivized adjective: ’the like (one)’ (τὸν ὁμοῖον)
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. sg.: ’her, with her’ · also adverbial, ’there, in that place’, pointing back to a place just named (τῇ τόν γε μένον λοχόωντες ’there they lay in wait for him’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., serving as an instrumental, ’with which’ (ῥάβδον, τῇ τ’ ἀνδρῶν ὄμματα θέλγει ’a wand, with which he charms men’s eyes’), not the personal pronoun · also relative adv., ’where, in the place where’ (τῇ δή μοι ἐείσατο χῶρος ἄριστος) · also adverbial, ’in that (event)’, pointing back to a contest just named: τῇ δ’ αὖτ’ Εὐρύαλος ἀπεκαίνυτο ’in that Euryalus in turn outdid all’ · also relative adv. of manner, with περ: ’in just the way that’ · also adv. of direction, ’thither, that way’ · also with a noun, article-like: fem. dat. sg. ’the’ (τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., of respect or means: ’in which, by which’ (ἀγλαΐην, τῇ … κέκασσαι ’the beauty by which you excel’)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’ · also with a noun, article-like: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων ’of the other winds’ · also distributive, ’of the one … of the other’ (τῶν μὲν … τῶν δ’ ’of the one band … of the other’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: gen. pl. ’of whom, whose’ (τῶν ὕβρις τε βίη τε … ἵκει ’whose insolence and violence reach’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’) · also adverbial ’therefore, and so’ (τῷ οὔ τινα οἶδα ’so I know no one’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the same’ (ἤματι τῷ αὐτῷ ’on that same day’) · also demonstrative instrumental, of a thing just named: ’with it’ (τῷ ἀπὸ πείσματ’ ἔκοψα ’with it I cut the cables off’) · also demonstrative of a thing just named, before a preposition: ’it’ (τῷ δ’ ἐν ’and on it’, τῷ δ’ ὑπό ’and beneath it’)
τῷδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc./neut. dat. sg., elided (τῷδ’ = τῷδε)
φέροντες: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: φίλον υἱόν ’dear son’ · also masc. acc. sg. predicative, agreeing with a pronoun: ’as a friend, welcome’ (φίλον ἐλθεῖν) · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φαίνετ: φαίνω — show; mid. appear; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (φαίνετ’ = φαίνετο): ’was appearing’
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φυλάσσω: φυλάσσω — keep watch, guard; pres. subj. 1 sg., + acc. of duration: ’keep watch through (the night)’ · also pres. indic. 1 sg.: ’I guard’ (σῦς τάσδε φυλάσσω ’I guard these swine’)
φωνήν: φωνή — voice, sound; fem. acc. sg.
φώνησέν: φωνέω — utter, speak aloud, call out; aor. 3 sg., accented φώνησέν before the enclitic τε
φῆμιν: φῆμις (Ionic-epic φήμη) — report, talk of people, rumour; fem. acc. sg.
χαλίφρων: χαλίφρων — slack-minded, foolish (χαλάω ’slacken’ + φρήν); adj., masc. nom. sg., rare compound
χαμάδις: χαμάδις — to the ground, groundward; adv.
ἀΰπνους: ἄϋπνος — sleepless; fem. acc. pl. (two-ending adjective), with νύκτας: ’sleepless’
ἀεικέα: ἀεικής — unseemly, shameful, unfitting; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. pl., used substantivally: ’unseemly things’ (ἀεικέα μερμηρίζων ’pondering unseemly things’) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with πήρην: ’unseemly, shabby (wallet)’ · also neut. acc. pl., attributive: ’shameful (deeds)’ (ἀεικέα ἔργ’) · also fem. acc. sg. (one form for masc. and fem.), agreeing with πήρην: ’unseemly’ (ἀεικέα πήρην ’an unseemly wallet’)
ἀθάνατοι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. nom. pl.: ’the immortals’
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀθρόοι: ἀθρόος — crowded together, all together; masc. nom. pl.
ἀλύξει: ἀλύσκω — escape, shun; fut. 3 sg. (ἀλύξω): ’will escape’
ἀμφ: ἀμφί (elided ἀμφ’) — around, about, concerning; + dat. · also + acc., ’around, with, accompanying’ (ἀμφ’ Ὀδυσῆα ’with, around Odysseus’) · also + gen., ’about, concerning’ (ἀμφ’ Ἄρεος φιλότητος ’about the love of Ares’) · also with ὀστεόφιν, ’around’ (ἀμφ’ ὀστεόφιν θὶς ’a heap around the bones’)
ἀμφίπολοι: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, attendant; fem. nom. pl. · also fem. voc. pl., address: ’handmaids!’
ἀμφιπόλοισι: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, attendant; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι
ἀμφιπόλων: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, attendant; fem. gen. pl.
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around, about; prep./adv. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ ... βάλλομεν = ἀμφιβάλλομεν ’we threw around, embraced’)
ἀνέβαιν: ἀναβαίνω — go up, mount; impf. 3 sg., elided and augmented (ἀνέβαιν’ = ἀνέβαινε): ’went up’
ἀναβᾶσα: ἀναβαίνω — go up; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.
ἀνθρώποισι: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἀνθρώπους: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; acc. pl.
ἀνῆκε: ἀνίημι — send up, rouse, stir (to something); aor. 3 sg., the gnomic aorist of a general truth · also simple aorist ’let go, released’, of sleep releasing a sleeper (τὴν δὲ γλυκὺς ὕπνος ἀνῆκε ’sweet sleep released her’)
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀσπαστὸν: ἀσπαστός — welcome; adj., neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’appeared welcome’
ἀσσοτέρω: ἀσσότερος — nearer; adv., comparative of ἄγχι (cf. ἆσσον): ’nearer’
ἀχαιαί: Ἀχαιαί (fem. of Ἀχαιός) — the Achaean women; fem. nom. pl.
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄεθλον: ἄεθλον — contest, prize (epic; = Attic ἆθλον); neut. acc. sg.
ἄκουσον: ἀκούω — hear, listen; aor. imper. 2 sg., + gen.: ’hear (me)’
ἄλλαι: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. nom. pl.
ἄλλο: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἄλλῃ: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’elsewhere’ · also fem. dat. sg. adjective, ’(at) another (woman)’ (ἄλλῃ νεμεσῶ)
ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
ἄνευθε: ἄνευθε(ν) — apart from, without; prep. + gen., epic (= Attic ἄνευ) · also adv., no case governed: ’apart, at a distance’ (αἱ δ’ ἄνευθε ’they lie apart’)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’ · also ἄρ before an elided κ’ (κε), ’then’, in a question: ἦ ἄρ κ’ ἐθέλοις ’would you then be willing?’
ἄριστος: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος ’best’; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἄρουραν: ἄρουρα — tilled land, plowland, earth; acc. sg.
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time as; adv./prep. + dat.
ἅμα: ἅμα — together with, at the same time as; adv./prep. + dat. · also ἅμα … τε, correlative: ’both … and’ (ἅμα τ’ αὐτῆς Πηνελοπείης … καὶ σέθεν εἵνεκα ’both for Penelope herself and for your sake’)
ἅπαντας: ἅπας — all, the whole, every; masc. acc. pl.
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐείκοσι: εἴκοσι — twenty; numeral, indeclinable, epic prothetic ἐ- (ἐείκοσι = εἴκοσι)
ἐθέλοις: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. opt. 2 sg.
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐκώκυον: κωκύω — wail, cry aloud (esp. a woman’s ritual lament); impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’wailed’
ἐλέφαντι: ἐλέφας — ivory, elephant; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with ivory’
ἐλαίῳ: ἔλαιον — olive oil; neut. dat. sg.
ἐλεύσεται: ἔρχομαι (fut. ἐλεύσομαι) — come, go; fut. 3 sg. mid.
ἐλθέμεν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. inf., epic ἐλθέμεν (= Attic ἐλθεῖν): ’to come’
ἐλθὼν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come’
ἐμήν: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. acc. sg.
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’ · also dat. of possession: ’mine is, I have’ (ἐμοὶ δ’ ὄνομα ’my name is’)
ἐμοῖσι: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic ἐμοῖς)
ἐμὰ: ἐμός — my, mine; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἐμὸς: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. nom. sg. · also the nominative form used as a vocative, agreeing with γαμβρός: ’my (son-in-law)!’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνίπλειον: ἐνίπλειος — full of, filled (+ gen.); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — here, to this place; adv.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐποψόμενος: ἐφοράω — look upon, visit; fut. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic ἐπόψομαι, of purpose: ’to look upon’
ἐπὴν: ἐπήν — when, whenever (= ἐπεὶ ἄν); conj. + subj. · also + opt. in a generalizing conditional clause, without a further ἄν/κε: ἐπὴν κρητῆρι μιγείη ’when it has been mixed’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: ἐπὶ … τέταλτο = ἐπιτέταλτο ’was laid upon, entrusted’ · also + acc. of time: ’for, over’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + dat., ’in charge of, over’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσιν ’over my possessions’) · also + dat., of purpose: ’for’ (ἐπὶ δόρπῳ ’for supper’) · also + dat., of the occasion: ’at, over’ (ἐπὶ ῥηθέντι δικαίῳ ’at a fair remark’)
ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσθλόν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. acc. sg. or neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἑκάστῳ: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. dat. sg.
ἑξείης: ἑξείης — in order, one after another; adv. (Attic ἑξῆς)
ἑοῖσιν: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); neut. dat. pl.: ’his own’
ἔδουσιν: ἐσθίω — eat; pres. 3 pl., from the epic present ἔδω (= Attic ἐσθίουσι)
ἔην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἔθηκαν: τίθημι — put, place, set; aor. 3 pl., built like the sg. ἔθηκε rather than the root-aorist (= Attic ἔθεσαν)
ἔκτανεν: κτείνω — kill; aor. 3 sg., epic ἔκτανε(ν) (= Attic ἀπέκτεινε)
ἔλθῃ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. subj. 3 sg.: ’may come’
ἔμ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (ἔμ’ = ἐμέ): ’me’
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔμπεδα: ἔμπεδος — steadfast, secure, firm; neut. acc. pl.
ἔν: ἐν — in, on; preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἔν … φῦ = ἐνέφυ ’took firm hold’) · also prep. + dat., ’on’, accented before the enclitic τε (ἔν τε τάπησι ’on rugs’)
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also used relatively, continuing a clause: ’where’ (ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’) · also doubled, ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’this way and that’
ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with anastrophe, accent thrown back after its noun (δήμῳ ἔνι = ἐν δήμῳ) · also = ἔνεστι, ἔνεισι (ἔνι with no case): ’there is, there are in it/among them’ (ἄνδρες νηῶν ἔνι τέκτονες ’men, shipwrights, are among them’)
ἔπε: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl. (ἔπεα, elided ἔπε’), epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔργ: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ἔργ’ = ἔργα) · also ’tilled land, farmed fields’ (Ἰθάκης … ἔργ’)
ἔς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; prep. + acc. · also with the adverb ὀπίσσω, ’for the time to come’ (ἔς περ ὀπίσσω ’even for the time to come’)
ἔσσεται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἔσται)
ἔστιν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., impersonal: ’it is possible’ · also plain copula, personal: ’is’ (ἀργύρεος ... ἔστιν ἅπας ’it is entirely silver’) · also with a dat. of the possessor, ’have’ (ἅσσα μοι ἔστιν ’whatever I have’) · also existential, ’there is’ (ἐν … νηὶ … βρῶσίς τε πόσις τε ἔστιν ’in the ship there is food and drink’)
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἕδνα: ἕδνον — bridal gift (given to the bride’s kin); neut. acc. pl.
ἕζετ: ἕζομαι — sit down; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἕζετ’ = ἕζετο), in tmesis with κατά: ’sat down’ · also plain, no tmesis: ’sat’ (ἕζετ’ ἔπειτ’ ἐπὶ θῖνα ’then sat down on the shore’)
ἕλοι: αἱρέω — take, seize, take hold of; aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with κε: ’would take hold of’ (of longing, + gen.)
ἕπωμαι: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; pres. subj. 1 sg. mid. (after ὄφρα): ’that I may go with (you)’
ἠγερέθοντο: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; impf. pass. 3 pl., epic -εθ- formation (= Attic ἠγείροντο)
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ) · also introducing the first alternative of a question: ’whether’ (ἠὲ διεπράθετο … ἦ … ’whether it was sacked … or …’) · also ’than’, after a word of difference (ἀλλοῖος … ἠὲ πάροιθεν ’different than before’) · also ’than’ after a comparative or word of preference (βέλτερόν ἐστι … ἠὲ ’it is better … than’) · also introducing the first alternative of a command: ’either’ (ἠὲ σὺ πρῶτος ἔσελθε ’either you go in first’)
ἠὼς: Ἠώς — Dawn; fem. nom. sg. · also a common noun, ’morning’ (ὄφρα μὲν ἠὼς ἦν ’as long as it was morning’)
ἡδέος: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; masc./neut. gen. sg.
ἡδὺν: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; masc. acc. sg.
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic ἠέ/ἤ) · also ’than’ after a comparative: κρεῖσσον … ἢ ὅτε ’better than when’ · also ’before’ after a verb of anticipating (ἔφθης … ἢ ἐγώ ’you got here before I did’) · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἔτι … ἦέ τις ’whether still … or someone’) · also ’than’ after a verb of preferring: βουλοίμην … ἢ … ἀνάσσειν ’I would rather … than rule’ · also introducing the first alternative of a deliberation: ’whether … or’ (ἢ ἐλάσει’ … ἦέ μιν ἦκ’ ἐλάσειε) · also ’than’ after a word of difference (ἀλλοῖον … ἢ Ὀδυσῆ’ ’another … than Odysseus’)
ἤ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj., accented before an enclitic (ἤ κεν); ἤ … ἦε ’whether … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative: μεῖζον … ἤ ’greater than’ · also ’than’, ’rather than’, after a verb of preferring (βούλομ’ … ἤ τινα ’I prefer … to any’)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤματα: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’all the days, every day’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’the days’ (νύκτες τε καὶ ἤματα φθίνουσιν)
ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
ἥβης: ἥβη — youth, young manhood, prime of life; fem. gen. sg. (ἥβης μέτρον ’the measure of manhood’)
ἥδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., fem. nom. sg.
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’) · also ’or’, the second alternative of a pair of questions with no preceding ἠέ: ζώει … ἦ τέθνηκε ’alive or dead’; ἢ ἔτ’ ἔχει … ἦ μιν ἀτιμάζουσιν ’whether … or’
ἦα: εἰμί — be; impf. 1 sg., epic ἦα (= Attic ἦν)
ἦρχε: ἄρχω — begin, rule; impf. 3 sg., + gen. ’began (the speaking)’ · also ’go first, lead the way’ (no gen.): ἦρχε δ’ Ἀθήνη ’and Athena went first, led the way’ · also + gen. of the way: ἦρχε ὁδοῖο ’led the way’ · also absolute: ’ruled, was king’
ἧος: ἧος — as long as, while; temporal conj., epic (= Attic ἕως) · also ’until’, and by extension ’so that’, introducing a purpose clause with the optative after a past main verb (ἧος … παύσειε ’so that it might stop her weeping’) · also plain temporal ’until’, with the indicative marking a definite past terminus: ἧος ... κατέπεφνεν ’until Artemis slew him’ · also ’until’ + optative, of an expected end (ἧος θερμαίνοιτο ’until it should grow hot’)
ἧχι: ἧχι — where; epic relative adv. (= Attic οὗ)
ἰκαρίου: Ἰκάριος — Icarius, father of Penelope; masc. gen. sg.
ἱσταμένοιο: ἵσταμαι — stand; of a month, begin; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’beginning’
ἴδηται: εἶδον (aor. of ὁράω) — see; aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., in a generalizing temporal clause: ’when he looks (them) over’ · also aor. subj. mid. 3 sg. after πρίν γε, ’until’: ’until she has seen (me)’ (πρίν γ’ αὐτόν με ἴδηται)
ὀΐομαι: ὀΐω — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. mid., epic ὀΐομαι: ’I think’ (+ acc. and inf.)
ὀδυρομένη: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn for; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
ὀδυρομένην: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn, grieve; pres. part. fem. acc. sg.
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; acc. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆα)
ὀδυσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆος)
ὀλοφυρομένη: ὀλοφύρομαι — lament, wail, mourn; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
ὀνείρῳ: ὄνειρος — dream; masc. dat. sg., with εἴκελον: ’like a dream’
ὀνομαστήν: ὀνομαστός — to be named, nameable, famous; fem. acc. sg., with οὐκ: ’not to be named’
ὀρώρεται: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; perf. mid. 3 sg. ὀρώρεται: ’is stirred up’
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also article-like with an adjective and a name: ’the’ (ὁ θρασὺς Ὀδυσσεύς ’bold Odysseus’) · also article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’) · also distributive, masc. nom. sg.: ’the one’ (ὁ μὲν οὐρανὸν εὐρὺν ἱκάνει ’the one reaches the broad heaven’) · also article-like with a superlative: ’the worst’ (ὁ κάκιστος Ἀχαιῶν ’the worst of the Achaeans’)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄλεθρος: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin; masc. nom. sg.
ὄνειρον: ὄνειρος — dream (Homeric also has the neut. by-form ὄνειρον, τό, beside the masc.); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary-sequence verb: ὄφρα ... ἕλοις/ἵκοιο ’so that you might take/arrive’ · also temporal + indic., ’as long as’ (ὄφρα μὲν … ἦν ’so long as it was’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron. (indefinite with τε/τις: ὅν τινα = ὅστις, ’whatever’); masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τινά · also plain relative pron., masc. acc. sg., not accented for a following enclitic: ’whom’ (ὅν ῥα καθεῖσεν ’whom he had stationed’)
ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in order that, how; + subj. or fut. indic. · also + opt., in secondary sequence after a past-tense verb, indirect deliberative: ’how it might’ (ὅπως ἄριστα γένοιτο ’how it might turn out best’) · also ’when’ = ὅτε · also ’as, however’ + subj. in a general clause: ὅπως ἐθέλῃσιν ’however he wishes’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might follow’ (ὅπως … ἑποίατο) · also + pres. indic., ’as, in whatever way’ (ὅπως ἐθέλεις ’as you wish’) · also ’how’ + aor. indic., indirect question after a verb of telling (κατάλεξον ὅπως ἤντησας ’tell how you came upon’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’ · also with τις, indefinite relative: ὅς τις … φάγοι ’whoever should eat’
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’) · also with the optative, iterative in past time: ’whenever’ (ὅτε μέλλοι ’whenever he was about to’) · also with the pres. indic., ’whereas, when’ (ὅτε τ’ ἄλλοι ἅπαξ θνῄσκουσ’ ἄνθρωποι ’whereas other men die only once’) · also in ὅτε μή, ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ θεὸς … θείη ’unless a god should make’)
ὑπερώϊα: ὑπερῷον — upper room, upper storey; neut. pl., epic ὑπερώϊα (= Attic ὑπερῷα), acc. of goal
ὑπερώϊον: ὑπερῷον — upper room, upper storey; neut. acc. sg., epic ὑπερώϊον (= Attic ὑπερῷον)
ὑπερῷ: ὑπερῷον — upper story, upper chamber; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὑπερῷ’ = ὑπερῷα)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., of manner: ’as’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I shall say’) · also comparative ’like’, standing before its noun (ὡς νυκτερίς ’like a bat’) · also ὡς ὅθ’ (= ὡς ὅτε), ’as when’, comparing with an occasion in the past (ὡς ὅθ’ ὑπὸ Τροίην ’as when beneath Troy’) · also introducing an indirect statement after a verb of saying: ’that, how’ (εἴποιμ’ ὡς … ἔρχομαι ’I might tell how I am coming’) · also ὡς ἄν + opt., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἄν τίς σε … μακαρίζοι ’so that someone … would call you blessed’) · also ὡς + participle, ’as one who’ (ὡς ἐκ θανάτοιο φυγόντα ’as one escaped from death’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν … ἔρχησθον ’so that you two may go’) · also ὡς = ’to, toward’ + acc. of a person (ὡς τὸν ὁμοῖον ’to the like’) · also exclamatory ὡς + finite verb: ’how’ (ὡς ὁ μολοβρὸς … ἀγορεύει ’how the glutton talks’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὥρη: ὥρα (Ionic ὥρη) — season, the right time, hour; fem. nom. sg. (Ionic η = Attic ᾱ): ’it is time (for)’
ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’) · also with κεν + opt., purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also ὥς ’just as’, in ὥς περ (accented before enclitic περ) (ὥς περ ὑπέστης ’just as you promised’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic με (ὥς με κελεύεις ’as you bid me’) · also postpositive after its noun, comparative ’like’ (οἰωνῶν ὥς ’like birds’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τοι (ὥς τοι ἐγὼν ἐρέω ’as I shall tell you’) · also correlative ’so’ answering ὅπως, introducing a wish with the opt., accented before the enclitic τοι: ’so may’ (ὥς τοι Ζεὺς τελέσειεν ’so may Zeus fulfil it for you’) · also with a plain subj. (no κε/ἄν), purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς τοι δῶρ’ ἀποπέμψω ’so that I may send you the gifts’) · also ὥς accented before enclitic οἱ, of measure: ’as much as’ (ὥς οἱ χεῖρες ἐχάνδανον ’as much as his hands could hold’) · also exclamatory, ’how’, accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τις θαρσαλέος … ἐσσι ’how bold you are’) · also with the plain optative (no κε/ἄν), purpose, accented before the enclitic μιν: ’so that’ (ὥς μιν ψυχὴ λίποι ’so that life should leave him’) · also ὡς ’as, how’, accented before enclitic μοι (ὥς μοι ἰνδάλλεται ’as it seems to me’) · also ὡς ’how’, introducing a narrated event, accented before the enclitic μιν (ὥς μιν θηρεύοντ’ ἔλασεν ’how he struck him as he hunted’)
ᾤχετ: οἴχομαι — go, be gone; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ᾤχετ’ = ᾤχετο): ’went’
ῥ: ἄρα (weakened ῥα, elided ῥ’) — then, indeed, so; inferential particle
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
